profile.headline: Engineering Manager of Customer Technology at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
Online web-services support.  Support highly scalable websites including performance tunning, monitoring, design, application interface

Specialties: Google GCP services , server architecture, webservices design and support including monitoring and troubleshooting.  Pipeline setup for continuous integration and deployment. 

Google Cloud Certified:  Associate Cloud Engineer

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Deploy highly scalable services in Google Compute projects. SRE lifestyle

positions.title: Project Lead, Online Applications Management
positions.description: I manage many e-commerce websites, as well as supporting applications.

positions.title: Senior Application Analyst
positions.description: , etc. 10+ production websites.  Senior analyst in Application support group of 6 people. Development, Test, QA and Production support for websites with iplanet/sunONE webserver 6.1sp8/apache,  UNIX admin, 100+ servers Sun T5120/T5140/490/480R/V240s Solaris 10, Redhat 5, jboss and  weblogic,  BigIP and ATG dynamo 2006.3 and Oracle 10g/10.2.0.4 Java 1.4/1.5 tuning. ATG dynamo Application support and deployment, and MKS Configuration Management. Twiki/mediawiki Documentation, keynote loadpro load testing. Perl/DBI/shell scripts; Architect and Visionary for group as well as main implementer.

positions.title: EDI Specialist
positions.description: Create and monitor file transfers within and out of company network.  Utilize AIX 5.2 Unix, Windows XP environments.  Multi Platform oriented including NDM (Connect:  Direct).  Work closely with business groups to ensure business needs are met.  Use Korn Shell script with FTP, SSH, SCP, SFTP, and NDM to transfer files.  Java/Tomcat utilization for file transmission reporting.  Utilization of Perl logging application in support of jobs monitoring.

positions.description:

Work closely with business groups to ensure business needs are met
Have directly automated and supervised automation of 70% of my team’s jobs

Java application programming

Multi Platform oriented including NDM (Connect:  Direct).  Work closely with business groups to ensure business needs are met. Java/Tomcat utilization for file transmission reporting.

positions.title: Technical Systems Support
positions.description:
Prepare systems to client’s configuration
Deliver computers to major corporations
Install computers and verify integrity of configuration
Provide on and off site technical support to clients

positions.title: Technical Systems Support
positions.description: Prepare systems to client's configuration.  Deliver computers to major corporations.  Install computers and verify integrity of configuration.  Provide on and off site technical support to clients.  Typical orders were for laptops, printers, and projectors.  Some orders were as large as 100 desktops with printers and all equipment networked together for a short conference week.  A typical day of delivery consisted of picking up and delivering equipment to/from client's sites.  We would completely setup and break down all necessary components for a standard desktop system.  Ensure all equipments worked as needed by customer before leaving client's site.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Worked with the Veterans Benefits student office and the Financial Aid office to assist students with enrollment and verification.  Helped students with questions concerning how to enroll as a Veteran in the benefits program and on-going through the school year for benefits.  Helped students enroll in and maintain Financial Aid status.

positions.title: College Student
positions.description: Attended college courses towards Associates Degree.

positions.title: AW3
positions.description: Utilized computers and various technologies to track submarines.  Went to many different schools including oceanography to learn to use all of the technologies and environment to best detect and track submarines.  Flew in S-3 Viking aboard aircraft carrier in missions to track submarines as well as detect enemy radar signatures for intelligence gathering.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Systems Security/Information Assurance
